headline: AMEA Power Signs $650 Million Wind Agreements in Egypt
summary: AMEA Power signed contracts for the 500 MW Amunet 2 wind project in Ras Shukeir and an agreement to build Egypt's first wind turbine factory.
why: Egypt is actively building renewable energy capacity to expand domestic generation and export potential.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: New renewable projects and industrial manufacturing investment boost green energy infrastructure.
